featured.summaryZh: 美国参议院预算文件披露了名为“B94”的新型核弹代号，建议拨款7710万美元用于相关研发。外界普遍认为这是美方旨在增强打击深层地下目标能力的信号。
featured.whyImportant: 美国核武库现代化进程的推进可能引发全球军备竞赛的担忧。

featured.titleZh: 黄仁勋回归引发美国政治反弹，英伟达盘前股价下跌
featured.summaryZh: 黄仁勋在争议中重返英伟达引发美国两党议员不满，质疑总统干预企业董事会决策的合法性。市场担忧英伟达对人工智能产业的系统性重要性，以及其在复杂政治环境下的未来前景。
featured.whyImportant: 该事件引发了关于科技巨头是否“大到不能倒”以及政治干预企业治理的广泛讨论。

featured.titleZh: Cop31会议凸显了气候融资存在的问题
featured.summaryZh: 澳大利亚气候部长在Cop31会议上强调，国际社会正面临气候变化、能源安全及人工智能电力需求等多重危机。他呼吁通过国际合作来应对这些挑战，并对多边主义的有效性表示肯定。
featured.whyImportant: 该会议反映了全球在应对复杂气候挑战时，对国际合作机制与资金分配问题的持续关注。

featured.titleZh: 日本为何将导弹演习移至印度领土进行
featured.summaryZh: 印度允许日本军队在其境内进行实弹导弹演习，标志着两国军事合作迈向新高度。分析认为，双方在应对中国挑战方面的共同关切正推动其防务关系进一步深化。
featured.whyImportant: 印日防务合作的升级反映了印太地区地缘政治格局的调整。

featured.titleZh: 俄罗斯无人机侵犯波兰领空，此前该国刚遭巡航导弹袭击
featured.summaryZh: 波兰当局正调查一起涉及俄罗斯无人机的“蓄意活动”，加剧了北约东翼的紧张局势。与此同时，匈牙利总理马扎尔宣布将访问乌克兰外喀尔巴阡地区，这是自2015年以来匈牙利总理首次访乌。

featured.title: What happens if a nuclear weapon explodes in space?
featured.summary: Earth's atmosphere offers protection from a nuclear blast in space, but satellites are more exposed. We explain how radiation could damage them, why the effects can linger and what protection is possible.
featured.titleZh: 如果核武器在太空中爆炸会发生什么？
featured.summaryZh: 地球大气层能提供一定的保护，但太空中的卫星将直接暴露在核爆炸的辐射之下。文章解释了辐射如何损坏卫星，以及为何其影响具有持久性及可能的防护措施。
featured.whyImportant: 随着太空军事化风险增加，了解核爆炸对轨道资产的潜在破坏性具有重要的战略意义。

featured.title: Pakistan’s Zeeshan Ali set for historic flight to China’s space station
featured.summary: The Pakistan Air Force pilot will spend about a week on board the Tiangong, conducting experiments with China’s crew.
featured.titleZh: 巴基斯坦飞行员齐尚·阿里将开启前往中国空间站的历史性飞行
featured.summaryZh: 巴基斯坦空军飞行员齐尚·阿里将前往中国天宫空间站，进行为期约一周的驻留。期间他将与中国航天员共同开展科学实验。
featured.whyImportant: 此次任务标志着巴基斯坦与中国在载人航天领域的合作迈出了重要一步。

featured.titleZh: 中国反腐机构调查科技部高级官员刘敏
featured.summaryZh: 据中央纪委国家监委消息，科技部高级官员刘敏因涉嫌严重违纪违法正接受纪律审查。目前，该调查由科技部纪检监察组及湖北省宜昌市监委共同开展。
featured.whyImportant: 此举显示中国政府持续加强对科技领域关键岗位的反腐力度。

global.title: Leader of India’s Cockroach movement says he was stopped from boarding flight to UK
global.summary: Saurav Das was due to give talks at UK universities on protest movement but says ‘coward government’ prevented him flying A leader of India’s youth-led Cockroach movement has said he was prevented from leaving Delhi to fly to the UK to give talks on the viral group’s protests. Saurav Das, 27, has been at the forefront of the Cockroach Janta party (CJP), which has amassed millions of social media followers since its launch in May. Das, who was due to fly out early on Tuesday, said immigration officials told him at the airport that his passport had been flagged. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 印度“蟑螂运动”领导人称被禁止登机前往英国
global.summaryZh: 印度青年抗议组织“蟑螂运动”的领导人索拉夫·达斯表示，他在德里机场被移民官员拦截，无法前往英国进行演讲。他声称自己的护照被标记，并指责政府采取了阻挠行动。
global.whyImportant: 该事件引发了关于印度政府对异见人士出境限制及言论自由状况的讨论。

global.title: Trump, Nvidia and power: could we be nearing the end of tech’s Gilded Age?
global.summary: Oligarchs believe they’re untouchable – the blue wave offers hope that the rampant corruption of the Trump era may soon be over One can imagine high-fives all around Nvidia’s boardroom after the board reinstated Jensen Huang to the CEO suite. The market gave the move a fat thumbs-up, boosting Nvidia’s share price by about a third. Shareholders, whose interests the board is meant to represent, are surely happy. But like Fifa’s controversial decision to defer the one-match suspension of US forward Folarin Balogun after receiving a red card for a foul on Bosnia and Herzegovina’s Tarik Muharemović during the World Cup over the summer, Huang’s absolution might backfire. Eduardo Porter is a journalist focused on economics and politics. He writes the newsletter Being There on Substack Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 特朗普、英伟达与电力：我们是否正接近科技“镀金时代”的终结？
global.summaryZh: 文章探讨了英伟达高层变动对市场的影响，并质疑科技巨头在当前政治环境下的权力扩张。作者认为，这种不受约束的权力可能正面临转折点。
global.whyImportant: 该评论反映了市场对科技巨头垄断地位及企业治理与政治环境相互作用的深层担忧。

global.title: Hong Kong school reminded on rest after requiring night study for lagging pupils
global.summary: Hong Kong’s education authorities have reminded a secondary institution to “fully consider students’ rest schedules” after it required underperforming Form Six pupils to stay until 8.30pm for a three-hour tutorial and self-study session. The reminder followed a student’s complaint to local media that pupils who were absent from the required extra school hours without prior approval would be considered truants, criticising the policy as unreasonable and “trading their health for grades”. global.titleZh: 香港一学校因要求落后学生参加夜间补习被提醒注意休息时间
global.summaryZh: 香港教育部门提醒一所中学需充分考虑学生的休息安排，此前该校要求成绩落后的六年级学生留校至晚上8点半进行补习。有学生投诉该政策不合理，认为是在以健康换取成绩。
global.whyImportant: 此事件引发了关于香港教育体系中过度竞争及学生身心健康平衡的社会讨论。

global.title: Hacked Russian data suggests nearly 500,000 soldiers dead, reports say
global.summary: Data allegedly stolen by hackers from Russia’s statistics agency Rosstat show the number of recorded Russian military dead is approaching 500,000, several Russian media outlets and German news magazine Der Spiegel reported on Monday. The outlets said they had gained access to the data set, which the hacker groups Cyberpartisans and Silent Crow are said to have taken in an attack on the agency. Reports said the groups were close to the Belarusian opposition or to pro-Ukrainian...
global.titleZh: 报道称被黑客窃取的俄罗斯数据显示死亡士兵近50万人
global.summaryZh: 据多家媒体报道，黑客组织从俄罗斯统计局窃取的数据显示，俄军死亡人数已接近50万。这些数据据称由亲乌克兰或白俄罗斯反对派背景的黑客获取。
global.whyImportant: 若数据属实，这将揭示俄乌冲突中俄方遭受的巨大人员损失，可能对战争进程产生深远影响。

global.summary: When Jensen Huang walked back into Nvidia’s headquarters in Santa Clara on Monday – without his trademark black leather jacket – the applause from cheering staff momentarily drowned out nearly two weeks of corporate turmoil. “I’m going to be a better CEO the second time around,” Huang told the crowd, joking that he would need the IT department to set him up with a computer on his first day back. The emotional homecoming marked a stunning reversal just 11 days after Huang’s abrupt resignation...
global.titleZh: 黄仁勋重返英伟达获员工欢呼，未穿标志性皮夹克
global.summaryZh: 在辞职11天后，黄仁勋重返英伟达总部并受到员工热烈欢迎。他表示将以更好的状态担任首席执行官，此次回归标志着该公司近期动荡局势的重大转折。
global.whyImportant: 黄仁勋的回归对英伟达的稳定及全球人工智能产业的发展具有关键影响。

china.title: Chinese drug stocks sink as US lawmakers threaten curbs on cross-border collaboration
china.summary: Chinese healthcare stocks fell on Tuesday amid intensifying threats from Washington, where lawmakers warned about the US drug industry’s “dangerous dependence” on China and urged restrictions on cross-border collaboration. “We cannot allow China to get ahead and control drug development, or it will use that power against us,” John Moolenaar, chairman of the US House Select Committee on China, said in a statement on Tuesday, adding that “urgent action is needed”. china.titleZh: 美国议员威胁限制跨境合作，中国医药股下跌
china.summaryZh: 美国众议院中国问题特别委员会警告称美方对中国医药产业存在危险依赖，并呼吁限制跨境合作。受此消息影响，中国医药板块股价出现下滑。

china.summary: Asia-Pacific stock markets rise after US president says he ‘convinced’ chipmaker’s board to reinstate CEO Comment: Nvidia’s humiliated board should resign out of embarrassment Business live – latest updates Donald Trump made up to $15m (£11.5m) on his holdings of Nvidia stock after the US chipmaker’s share price soared on the surprise return of Jensen Huang as chief executive. items.title: Dutch minister heads to China as Nvidia saga revives US push for tougher ASML curbs
items.summary: Dutch Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen’s visit to China this week comes amid a shifting dynamic in the Netherlands’ efforts to fend off further US restrictions on ASML sales to Beijing following the Nvidia saga, analysts say, with some suggesting it could strengthen the Dutch case against the proposed measures despite mounting pressure from Washington. “Because of the Nvidia [saga], there is a renewed push for the Match Act in the US Congress,” said Frans-Paul van der Putten, founder of...
items.titleZh: 荷兰大臣访华，英伟达事件重燃美国对阿斯麦施压
items.summaryZh: 荷兰外交大臣本周访华，旨在应对美国因英伟达事件而推动的更严厉出口限制。分析指出，荷兰正试图在华盛顿的压力下维护其半导体设备的对华贸易利益。
items.whyImportant: 此举凸显了荷兰在美中半导体技术博弈中面临的复杂外交与经济压力。

items.title: Trump made up to $15m on Nvidia stock after Huang’s return
items.summary: Asia-Pacific stock markets rise after US president says he ‘convinced’ chipmaker’s board to reinstate CEO Comment: Nvidia’s humiliated board should resign out of embarrassment Business live – latest updates Donald Trump made up to $15m (£11.5m) on his holdings of Nvidia stock after the US chipmaker’s share price soared on the surprise return of Jensen Huang as chief executive. Huang, who co-founded the company in 1993, was ousted by the board after allegations that he had three affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy and two with employees. But the Nvidia board reinstated him after an intervention from the US president. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普在黄仁勋回归后通过英伟达股票获利高达1500万美元
items.summaryZh: 在特朗普干预促成黄仁勋重返英伟达后，该公司股价大涨，特朗普持有的英伟达股票价值随之飙升。此前黄仁勋因个人丑闻被董事会罢免，此次回归引发了关于总统干预企业决策的争议。
items.whyImportant: 总统直接干预企业人事并从中获利引发了严重的道德与利益冲突质疑。

items.title: China approves 2-month extension of select US export restrictions
items.summary: China has extended the suspension of some export restrictions on dual-use items to the United States by two months, maintaining a temporary easing of curbs on critical minerals and other materials amid a broader cooling of tensions between the world’s two largest economies. The Ministry of Commerce said the suspension of the second clause of its dual-use export control announcement to the United States would remain in effect through January 27. The original measures, introduced in December 2024...
items.titleZh: 中国批准将部分对美出口限制措施延长两个月
items.summaryZh: 中国商务部宣布，将针对部分两用物项对美出口限制措施的暂停期延长两个月，至2027年1月27日。此举旨在维持关键矿产等物资出口限制的暂时放宽，以缓解中美两大经济体之间的紧张关系。
items.whyImportant: 此举显示出中美在关键供应链领域的紧张局势出现阶段性缓和迹象。

items.title: How US restrictions on China are reshaping the science race
items.summary: As the United States and China compete for scientific leadership, Washington and a growing number of states are imposing restrictions on academic ties with China. Since 2018, Congress and 23 states have introduced 158 bills curbing how US universities work with foreign scientists, students and institutions; 24 became law, according to a new tracker from the Committee of 100, a non-profit organisation of prominent Chinese Americans. Its interactive map shows 13 states with a law or executive...
items.titleZh: 美国对华限制如何重塑科学竞赛格局
items.summaryZh: 随着美中在科学领导力方面的竞争加剧，美国国会及多个州政府正通过立法限制与中国的学术交流。据统计，自2018年以来已有大量相关法案被提出，旨在管控美国大学与外国科学家及机构的合作。
items.whyImportant: 学术交流限制的增加可能对全球科研合作及人才流动产生深远影响。

items.title: First Lady Melania Trump Hails America’s Armed Forces
items.summary: Declaring precision and mental strength the foundation of global military superiority As families across America prepare to celebrate Thanksgiving, First Lady Melania Trump addressed members of America’s armed forces at Joint Base Andrews, “The US military is the most powerful military in the world because of its people. Our warriors train relentlessly, pushing the boundaries […] The post First Lady Melania Trump Hails America’s Armed Forces appeared first on The White House.
items.titleZh: 第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普赞扬美国武装部队
items.summaryZh: 在感恩节前夕，第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普在安德鲁斯联合基地向美军致辞。她强调美军的全球优势源于其人员的专业素质与坚韧训练。
items.whyImportant: 此举体现了美国政府对军队士气的重视及对军事力量的公开支持。

items.title: Congressional Bills H.R. 1550, H.R. 4930, and H.R. 8552 Signed into Law
items.summary: On Monday, November 23, 2026, the President signed into law: H.R. 1550, the “Strengthening America’s Turning Point Act,” which redesignates the Saratoga National Historical Park as the Saratoga National Battlefield Park; H.R. 4930, which expands U.S. Customs and Border Protection’s authority to share information about imports suspected of violating United States intellectual-property-rights with the rights holders, online […] The post Congressional Bills H.R. 1550, H.R. 4930, and H.R. 8552 Signed into Law appeared first on The White House.
items.titleZh: 美国国会法案H.R. 1550、H.R. 4930及H.R. 8552签署成为法律
items.summaryZh: 美国总统于11月23日签署了多项法案，其中包括将萨拉托加国家历史公园重新命名为萨拉托加国家战场公园，以及扩大海关和边境保护局在打击侵犯知识产权进口商品方面的执法权限。
items.whyImportant: 这些法律的签署将直接影响美国历史遗迹管理及知识产权保护的执法力度。

items.title: Thailand agrees new durian export rules with China to protect US$5 billion trade
items.summary: China and Thailand have agreed a new sanitation protocol for exports of Thai durian to raise Beijing’s “confidence” in the trade and protect billions of dollars’ worth of shipments, according to Thailand’s Ministry of Commerce. The two governments updated plant health guidelines and procedures to clarify shipping requirements and establish a “systematic” approach to managing quarantine pests, the ministry announced on Sunday via its official website. “This is intended to build confidence among...
items.titleZh: 泰国与中国达成新的榴莲出口规则，以保护50亿美元贸易额
items.summaryZh: 中泰两国就泰国榴莲出口达成新的卫生检疫协议，旨在规范检疫流程并提升中方对进口产品的信心。此举旨在保障两国间价值数十亿美元的农产品贸易稳定运行。
items.whyImportant: 该协议有助于稳定中泰农产品贸易，并为双边农业合作提供更明确的监管框架。

items.title: Wars choke global food routes, threatening aid for 7.3 million, WFP warns
items.summary: WFP Executive Director Luke Lindberg decries ‘political problem’ as grain is 'not reaching the people who need it'.
items.titleZh: 世界粮食计划署警告：战争阻断全球粮食通道，730万人援助受阻
items.summaryZh: 世界粮食计划署执行主任卢克·林德伯格指出，政治问题导致粮食无法送达急需人群。战争冲突严重干扰了全球粮食供应链，威胁到数百万人的生存。
items.whyImportant: 全球粮食运输受阻加剧了脆弱地区的人道主义危机。

items.title: Campaigners urge Albanese government to reject ‘climate bomb’ coalmine expansion after Cop31
items.summary: Hunter Valley Operations expansion in New South Wales would allow additional 430m tonnes of coal to be extracted and burned Sign up for climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s free Clear Air newsletter here Climate campaigners are urging the Albanese government to heed a “line in the sand” warning on fossil fuels issued by dozens of countries at a UN climate summit and refuse a massive coalmine expansion planned in New South Wales. A proposed agreement at the Cop31 negotiations in Turkey failed after a list of nations – including European Union members, Panama, the Marshall Islands, Vanuatu, Norway and Belize – said they would not support it unless it included an explicit statement that the world needed to transition away from fossil fuels. items.titleZh: 环保人士敦促阿尔巴尼斯政府在Cop31后拒绝“气候炸弹”煤矿扩建项目
items.summaryZh: 环保人士呼吁澳大利亚政府拒绝新南威尔士州的一项大型煤矿扩建计划，该计划涉及额外开采4.3亿吨煤炭。此前在土耳其举行的Cop31气候峰会上，多国因未能就化石燃料转型达成共识而导致协议流产。
items.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了澳大利亚在气候承诺与化石燃料产业利益之间的政策博弈。
